[zeropress-build-pages] Invalid site config: test/fixtures/prebuild-errors/invalid-site-url/documents/.zeropress/config.json
Reason: site.url must use the origin root without a path, query, or fragment. Subdirectory hosting is not supported.

Expected:
  "site": { "url": "https://example.com" }
Omit site.url or use an empty string when the deployment URL is not known.
